narrative: Round 0 raised real issues: a pre-lock frame read, a fallible place, a stale RankSet in the memory engine, and a liveness gap in frameMateIndexes. The 3aee33b fixes created most of round 1. frameOfTx added a self-row deleted_at filter that broke parity (F12/F14/F20). The in-place RankSet permutation combined with the live-only frameMateIndexes to drop live siblings (F15/F17/F19, S5 data loss). The deferral of the relative-verb race turned out wrong (F18). Rounds 2-3 then found a deleted-issue refusal that held only pre-lock and only for the written id, plus incomplete sweeps of a test arm, a message prefix, and a CLI output string. The review hit the 5-round cap with the head commit unreviewed.
guidance_observations: Three of five deferrals or partial sweeps (F1/F5 recurrence, F4 --bottom arm, F9 output string) came back as later findings; checking the base branch and grepping every surface of a changed behavior before the first fix would have removed rounds 2-3.
Fixes that added new filters (frameOfTx deleted_at, live-only frameMateIndexes) were not re-checked against the code they paired with in the same commit, which produced the S5 data-loss regression.

The agent repeatedly wrote a guarantee into the CHANGELOG or a comment ('on both engines', 'refusal holds even when the delete lands mid-move', 'nothing else') before tracing the substitution and race paths; reviewers then found each overclaim.
The 5-round cap ended review with the last fix commit (485d9fa) unreviewed, so the length of the fix chain directly cost review coverage.
